title: fairctl -output json: a failure before the command's result
description: F-014 T-12 (design §3.4, AC-54): the one JSON document a fairctl command prints with -output json when it stops before its own result exists: a usage error, a refused decisions file, a command not yet available in this build, an interruption or an unreachable environment. internal/installer.ErrorDocument is the authority; cmd/fairctl's TestFairctlOutput checks every command's output against this schema.

command.description: The command as named, e.g. install or backup run.

exit_code.description: 1 refused, 2 usage or invalid input (and commands not in this build), 3 interrupted (resumable), 4 environment unreachable.

problems.description: invalid_decisions: every problem with the decisions file, by field; never the value that looked secret.
